designNotes: A young adult female kemonomimi cat-girl with a punk-arcade glitch aesthetic. Dark skin, voluminous magenta curly afro shoulder-length, triangular fur-tufted cat ears matching hair color, slim tapered feline tail, warm yellow eyes, grounded anime face style with moderate eye size — not pushed toward exaggerated moe. 7.5 head heights — standard young adult proportions. Outfit aesthetic combines bustier/corset elements with arcade-fashion accents (fishnet hosiery, platform boots, belt accessories with charms). DiT.2 variant available under PixAI id 2007394339034365733 for benchmark comparison; swap linkedLoraId to test.
continuityRules: Hair color is magenta; no drift toward pink, purple, or red
Cat ears are triangular and fur-tufted, matching hair color exactly; not rounded, not differently colored
Tail is slim and tapered, not chunky or fluffy
Skin tone is dark; no drift toward light or olive
Eyes are warm yellow; no drift toward gold, amber, or green
Face style is grounded anime, not exaggerated moe; eyes should not be pushed larger than the reference sheet
Boots are mid-calf height with moderate platform sole; never knee-high, never oversized lug soles
Belt always carries the side chain with heart charm dangling
Fishnet hosiery reads as clear mesh, not solid coverage
No garter straps unless explicitly called for by a named outfit variant
